story: Tour Auvergne - Rhône-Alpes Stage 7 was neutralized because of gravel on the descent post-third climb. Paul Seixas crashed, losing 3.5 minutes, but returned after 60km chase with team support. On the final climb, Seixas was dropped immediately; Juan Ayuso attacked early but was overtaken by Isaac Del Toro, who won ahead of Ayuso and Tobias Halland Johannessen.
